programme.desc: North Pol Express: Dr Pol finds two chickens suffering from bare bums. While Dr Emily and Dr Nicole team up to visit a cow with a retained placenta - or so they think. (S9, ep 2)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Bring on the Bison!: Dr Schroeder treats a range of furry, feathered and scaly friends. (S2, ep 8) 7+

programme.title: The Hummingbird Effect
programme.desc: Venture across Costa Rica to witness the country's dazzling diversity of hummingbirds and learn how these tiny creatures play a massive role in one of the wildest environments on Earth. 7+

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: From vast deserts to lush tropical forests and from immense lakes to winding rivers, Africa is a continent of extremes. 7+

programme.title: Investigation Shark Attack
programme.desc: Maui Mayhem: The team investigates incidents off Maui in peak tourist season to discover why the island has more shark encounters than the entire Hawaiian chain. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Machines with Chris Barrie
programme.desc: 1940s: Chris discovers there's nothing like a war to get an inventor's cogs going, as he investigates fire pumps, radar, shrapnel-proof fire engines and tractors. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Don't Poke a Sleeping Porcupine: A young reindeer with many ailments needs Dr Oakley's help to get back into fighting shape, and an elderly porcupine poses a pokey problem. (S7, ep 5)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: North Carolina
programme.desc: Sweet Release: As the orphaned otter pups go to fish school, two young lions leave the pride and a dangerous antelope is darted on the zoo's grasslands. 7+ (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: New: Wild Crocs Of The Caribbean
programme.desc: Across the Caribbean, Cuban and American crocodiles share a rapidly changing world. As habitats shift and their paths increasingly cross, their survival hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Crocodile King
programme.desc: Documentary examining the hugely territorial crocodile, which fights for dominance, food and mates within its species, with the power falling on the biggest, most battle-tested croc. 7+

programme.title: Swamp Men
programme.desc: Swamp Shootout: As staff of Billi Swamp Safari return, the park is in chaos. With one gator on the loose and another threatening to eat her offspring, new recruits are tested. (S3, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Gridlock Hazard: Thord struggles to rescue a truck blocking a mountain pass while impatient drivers put his life in danger. (S5, ep 6) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Divide and Conquer: Simon interrupts two mating boomslang snakes to rescue them from a stone-throwing mob. Can he prevent them both from slithering away? (S6, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: The Bull Pen: Dr Pol and Charles start their day by heading out to see a sick ox at Matt Middleton's farm. The ox has lost weight and is having trouble breathing. 12+. (S3, ep 9)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Even If It Quills Me: Dr Oakley treats a moose with an eye injury, a rescued pig and a dog with a porcupine vendetta. 12+ (S8, ep 14)

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programme.desc: Salmon People: An exploration of the challenges faced by these resilient individuals as they strive to maintain their connection with nature. 7+. (S3, ep 15)

programme.title: Cruise TV With LoveitBookit
programme.desc: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Udder Madness: Dr Brenda removes an abscess from the head of a puppy, before Dr Pol determines why a horse is struggling to chew. Plus, Doc helps a pregnant cow. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Babies on Board: Meet the babies of the zoo, from adorable bouncy baby goats and a trio of fluffy flamingo chicks, to a sweet baby gazelle and a feisty eland calf. (S3, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: The Cape Crusaders: Simon and Siouxsie receive an SOS call from a fellow snake catcher in Cape Town when the city is swamped with cobras seeking refuge from blazing fires. (S3, ep 4)

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Predator Paradise: Journey to the untamed wilderness of Southern Africa's Bushveld region, home to some of the African continent's most iconic predators. U. (S8, ep 5)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: The Quest for Camel-ot: The Pol family says goodbye to a beloved pet. Plus, exotic creatures pay the clinic a visit, including two camels and a very noisy macaw. (S9, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: So Hard To Say Goat-Bye: The Schroeders castrate an aggressive alpaca, bring a mama dog back from the brink of death and save a horse from bleeding out. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: Wild Florida
programme.desc: Croc Coast: Explore the wild inhabitants of Florida's coral islands, lush mangroves and sandy beaches which include, crocodiles, sharks, rattlesnakes and deadly birds of prey. (2 of 2) 7+

programme.title: Wild Namib: Land Of Extremes
programme.desc: Explore Africa's southern coastal desert, where fur seals and penguins divide their time between the sandy shore and the icy sea water and ostrich and hyena roam the windswept dunes. 7+

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Urban Jaws: Investigate a devastating shark bite in Australia, hunting for clues in attacks across the globe before analysing the data in a cutting-edge lab. 12+. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Machines with Chris Barrie
programme.desc: 1910s: Chris looks back at 100 years of technology and inventions, beginning with the decade that produced the new weapons, trucks, planes and ships used in WWI. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: The Stricken Chicken: Dr. Oakley sees two stubborn muskoxen and a particularly wily coyote. A badly burned dog receives an innovative, if fishy, new treatment. (S7, ep 6)

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Chapter Three: The Greatest: Reunited with his family, Kio faces a harsh new reality. One fateful mistake changes everything, forcing the young lion to fend for himself. (3 of 4) 7+

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Chapter Four: To Be A King: Kio discovers a new kingdom, but powerful rivals stand in his way. To claim a pride and a future, he must fight for his crown. (4 of 4) 7+

programme.title: Wild Mediterranean
programme.desc: Untamed Coasts: A wealth of wildlife, including some of the world's most remarkable survivors, call the serene waters along the Mediterranean coastline home. 7+ (2 of 2)

programme.title: Swamp Men
programme.desc: One Bad Gator: Staff dice with death as they make three alligators move home. The park takes in a huge and dangerous bull gator. But can its staff contain the aggressive beast? (S3, ep2) 7+

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Moonlight Mayhem: Time is short and the police pile on the pressure when Thord struggles to get a 16-wheeler back on the road. (S5, ep 7) 7+

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: War Games: Mmamotse has turned the kingdom upside down but her legacy now depends on a princess taking the throne. Dikeledi prepares her cheetah cubs to cross enemy territory. (S3, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results in 'Fire Safety', then in 'Castle Catstrophe', Cheesy and Alvin cause an accident at a historic castle. (S5, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets bad reviews on the internet in 'You Troll', then in 'Life of the Party', The Chipmunks along with Kevin and Cheesy decide to crash BoCarter's party after not being invited. (S4, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin accidentally clones himself in 'Double Trouble', then in 'Liar Liar', Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore is desperate to land the part of the monster in the school play in 'Clowning Around', then in 'Bully For You', Simon builds a homemade robot bodyguard. (S1, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo. (S1, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks. (S3, ep 9)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room in 'A Room of One's Own', then in 'Carts and Crafts', Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bicycle, so enters a contest to win a new bike. (S1, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a reality show in 'I Will Survive', then in 'Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag', Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's bag and must replace it. (S1, ep 26)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin almost drives a local toy store out of business in 'Unboxing Day', then in 'Dave's Pavillion', Dave's new pavilion is surprisingly ruined for some reason. But who is to blame? (S5, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin's too short for a new amusement park ride in 'U-Fly', then in 'Yeti or Not', Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby, making life miserable for the rest of the family. (S5, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin dresses Theodore like a baby to impress the girl of his dreams in 'Baby Whisperer', then in 'Let's Make A Deal', making a present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon goes missing and no one else notices in 'Oh Brother Where Art Thou', then in 'The Wall', the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall. (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Pirates show up at the house in 'Pirates Life', then in 'World Record', The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game. (S4, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep in 'Dr. Sleep', then in 'Davey Boy', Alvin zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen. (S5, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets a parenting app to help supervise The Chipmunks in 'The App', then in 'Don Juan Theodoro', Alvin, Simon and the Chipettes give Theodore conflicting dating tips. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a film in 'Lights Camera Uh-Oh', then in 'Wax Dave', The Chipmunks fear Dave is in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a statue! (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices. (S3, ep 4)
